question: What does the warranty cover for your balcony safety nets in Chennai?
answer:
At GCM Netting Solutions in Chennai, we stand behind the quality of our balcony and children's safety nets. Our warranty typically covers manufacturing defects in the HDPE (High-Density Polyethylene) material and faulty installation. Our safety nets are UV stabilized to resist sun damage, ensuring long-lasting protection. Depending on the specific product and installation, our warranty ranges from 3 to 5 years. This warranty ensures that the net will maintain its structural integrity and effectiveness under normal usage conditions.

Specifically, the warranty covers issues such as excessive tearing, significant degradation of the net material leading to safety compromises, and detachment due to improper installation by our team. It's important to note that the warranty doesn't cover damage caused by misuse, accidents, or natural disasters. Our professional installation team ensures proper fitting and secure anchoring of the safety nets, minimizing the risk of such issues. We prioritize using high-quality materials and following best practices during installation to provide you with a reliable safety solution for your balcony. For more detailed information regarding the specific warranty terms for your chosen safety net and installation, please don't hesitate to call us at +91 99123 99224. We are happy to clarify any concerns regarding our safety nets Chennai and their installation process.
